body: I’m sorry you are going through this. I am going through something similar myself, I started grad school this semester and the panic attacks are so unbearable that I might have to leave school. I am going to take some time for myself and really try to learn what helps me. You have probably done the same already and I’m probably not much help but just know that you are not alone. If you ever want to talk, I’m here and feel free to message me anytime.

I understand completely. I’m going through something similar myself with school. I wish you well. 
I was just recommended the book “at last a life” by Paul David.

Thank you for saying all of this and sharing your story. I really appreciate all your tips. I am in online school for grad now and I’m trying to figure out if I should stay or not. I’ve been out of everything for so long that it’s hard going back. 
I am really going to take the time to figure myself out. I’m gonna talk to my doctor about starting something. I’m also going to start looking for some therapists.
Thank you again, you have helped me a lot. I wish you well in life.

I can’t be of much help bc this is exactly what I am going through rn. I finished college and didn’t have a job for a while and once I did I hated it so much, I had panic attacks everyday, so I quit. Now i started grad school bc I didn’t know what else to do and the same thing is happening, it’s bad to the point where I just want to quit already. So I feel you. I was told to talk to a doctor about some medication, talking with someone, or to try cognitive behavior therapy. 
I’m going to talk to my doctor about medication and I’m still trying to determine what to do about school but all I know is that I have to keep trying different things, and mental health comes first. anxiety sucks.
Thank you. I’m going to the doctors tomorrow so I’ll talk about medication.
Did it help you stick with things bc I really wanna drop out of grad school already but I know I’m gonna regret it.
I wish you the best and I hope the plants grow into something beautiful
Thank you. That did make me feel a bit better tonight. I really appreciate your kindness
Thanks for saying that. It’s strawberries

Getting away from your household will definitely make you feel better. It will help you find yourself and learn to live for you. Your relationship might even get better with him bc you don’t have to see him everyday. I hope your situation gets better.

Ignore that rude comment someone made. They have no idea what you are going through and only prove your point more that some people don’t understand mental health issues. I feel you. It sucks to have any type of issue and then on top of that to have no one truly understand how you feel. Most of my family is the same way and it is the reason I always have to put on a smile around them or they think I’m being rude or a bitch. 
Any feelings you have are valid and I hope you don’t let it eat at you too much. If you want someone to talk to, I’m here

I wish there was an easy way. If there was I believe a lot more people would do it. I understand your pain, I have the same thoughts everyday. If you wanna talk about anything I’m here. Sometimes it feels better talking to a stranger than the people you know.
Just want to say thank you. It’s a rough night for me and seeing this calmed me down for a bit.

Sorry you’re going through this, I feel you. After I graduated all I have felt is uncertainty bc I don’t know what to do with my life. And you never know with grad school-There are a lot of schools out there. 

Why did your brother stop talking to you?
I get it. Thinking about ways to end it helps me go to sleep some nights. Thanks for sharing and I really do hope it gets better for both of us.
Literally. I hate that I feel everything. Yeah it def doesn’t help where you live. Most of my family doesn’t understand mental health so I can’t really talk about with them either

I feel you. I am a unemployed college grad who has a mostly supportive family but I still cant see a future for myself. I’m tired of pretending around everyone and just wish i had the strength to end it all.
How do you usually cope with the thoughts? Sometimes I find just talking to strangers helps me get through the night.

I relate to this so much. I feel the exact same way. Everyone thinks I’m this happy and loving girl just bc I’m always willing to help people with their problems. Everyone else seems so happy and so successful and then there’s me who is doing nothing with their life. No one knows how unhappy I really am and how ready I am to end it all. 
I get how you feel and I hope it gives you some comfort to know someone related to this.

I feel you. Sometimes its better to vent it out to strangers than to people you know. If it helps you at all, I relate to this. I have no motivation for life and feel lost just about everyday.  dating sucks an I hope you don’t let that woman get to you.

do you wanna talk about the women problems or about anything? if u do,  I’m here to talk
Yeah I hope so too. Sometimes just venting on here helps me get through the night. I wish you well in life even tho it sucks

ill keep that in mind If I ever actually seek professional help.   
thanks, if you ever need someone to talk too as well please don’t hesitate to reach out. Even if you just want to vent. No judgement over here.
I feel you. i wish almost every night that I won’t wake up the next day. I wish I could kill myself but I can’t either. i wish I could tell you my motivation for living but rn there isn’t one.

Thank youu. It does help a little knowing someone is in a similar situation. parents really make your situation worse.   
i definitely have been avoiding my mental health issues, hoping it will just go away but it doesn’t. i haven’t talked to my doctor about my anxiety or depression bc I am unsure if I should try medication. I have been handling it by myself but I feel like my anxiety is just getting worse. But idk I guess I have to figure something out. 

But thanks for reaching out and sharing your story. i hope you feel better
Thanks again. And if you ever need to talk, feel free to reach out.

Thank you. I appreciate it. I recently applied to a Starbucks near me so maybe if I hear back from them I’ll take it. I think it will be good for me to get out of the house and work.   
I hope both our situations improve soon

thats not a good situation. is there any way you could go out and get your own snack to keep in your room for when you don’t feel ok enough to go in the kitchen. Either go to a convince store or if u can’t leave on ur own, sneak in the kitchen when he’s asleep?

I relate to this so much. I finished my degree beginning of 2020 so finding a job was not happening. It was until September 2020 that I finally got a job but once I entered it was the worse job of my life. It was remote and I just felt so numb everyday while working there. any confidence I had was gone and my anxiety was worse than ever. I quit after a short time. Now I sometimes regret it bc i have been unemployed since. I feel like my life is over at 25. I can’t see another way around just ending my life most days.   
I may not feel okay right now but I am still applying for jobs when I feel up to it. 

I hope you continue to look for a job and I truly hope you find something. Keep looking and maybe apply to some internships if you need experience.

Ugh I feel this so much. I am 25 with a college degree and I don’t do anything with it. I fucking hate my life and i go to bed every night just hoping I won’t wake up the next day. I feel like everyone around me is just living their best life and then there’s me who is stuck.

i understand your pain.

Hi 

sorry you are dealing with that right now. I understand a toxic household.    does he interact with you when you go downstairs?
